title: Crystal Ball
text: Craft a chest in the center with a spiritual crystal above, below, left and right. The crystal ball provides gentle illumination.
Right-click to open twelve storage slots. Stored items roam inside as miniatures, one display per occupied slot. Removing a stack removes its display.

Avoid repeatedly jumping on the globe. Every three landings add a crack stage; the third stage shatters it, releasing all contents and one glass block, but no crystal ball. Damage gradually heals when left undisturbed.
Crystal Balls also serve as loot containers in Apprentice Huts, Crystal Workshops and Wizard Towers. Unopened loot balls contain mist; opening one reveals its loot. Crafted balls start empty.
